method.code_analysis: AST only; project modules are never imported or executed
method.installed_versions: Selected distribution metadata versions only; no environment variables read
limitations: All AST import branches are included; this overapproximates actual startup dependencies.
Dynamic imports, subprocesses, runtime sys.path changes, compiled extensions and external tools mean this is not a complete execution closure.
Observed dynamic imports/process calls are listed without executing them or exporting arbitrary command arguments.
Stdlib classification describes this interpreter; platform-conditional dependencies may not be installed.
External asset stat/declared hashes do not prove actual content hashes, installation, compatibility, game fidelity or match acceptance.

non_python_components.role: 原生执行与 guest 软件图形；配置锁与 VM 磁盘分别管理
显式设备连接、只读身份核验与连续帧传输
主机 VP9/WebM 编码、PTS、完整解码和 seek 核验
当前 native manifest 逐项锁定的外部原生资源，源代码包不含完整素材
可选 Playwright 浏览器验收；浏览器与系统共享库需独立准备
保留本机启动器与独立 Windows 依赖锁
可选 Java/C++/APK 探针构建，使用项目内固定工具资源
历史近似基线需要匹配 Python ABI 的本地扩展；不是当前原生 libg

native_assets.size_totals_scope: declared_bytes sums only declared sizes; zero can mean declarations are absent. known_stat_bytes sums actual stat sizes of present regular files; missing or unsafe assets have unknown sizes.
native_assets.verification: Manifest bytes hashed; external asset existence/size only. Declared SHA256 values are not reverified, and runtime compatibility is not accepted.

windows_lock_policy.policy: Preserve historical Windows lock independently; do not overwrite or merge it with Linux cloud profiles.

source_checkout_policy: Current tools require the repository root, research/system.json and separately prepared data/runtime assets. This inventory does not promise an independently deployable wheel.
